sections.changelog:
== Changelog ==

= 1.3.1 =
fix: Removing WP Migrate moves its folder out of the plugins folder in one step and deletes the files after answering, so it can't stop halfway (1.3.0 could leave a half-deleted plugin). One action at a time per plugin, and an action finishes even if the dashboard stops waiting. Status reports commandsVersion 2.

= 1.3.0 =
feat: The WebCare dashboard can enable, disable or remove WP Migrate, and nothing else (POST /appex/v1/plugins, signed with its own key; enabling installs WP Migrate Pro from the dashboard where it's missing). The status endpoint also reports WP Migrate's push and pull settings and which actions the site supports.

= 1.2.1 =
feat: The plugin always updates itself automatically (no email to the site admin when it's the only update), and the update checker also loads on sites without ACF.

= 1.2.0 =
feat(status): Report whether search engines are discouraged from indexing the site (Settings > Reading).

= 1.1.0 =
feat(status): Report auto-update settings in the status endpoint: per plugin (and whether forced by code), WordPress core (major/minor/disabled) and whether the automatic updater is disabled.

= 1.0.99 =
feat(status): Add signed, read-only /wp-json/appex/v1/status endpoint reporting WordPress, PHP, theme and plugin versions and available updates for the WebCare dashboard.

= 1.0.98 =
